mods.name: status-strip
mods.summary: One quiet strip: repo, docs, deploy, context and cache, with small circular meters
mods.where: A thin dock line above the prompt while everything is fine (click ▸ to open it); it opens by itself when something needs you. Context and cache show a small circle (○ ◔ ◑ ◕ ●). During a push, merge or deploy it shows how long it has been going, and a "deploy it" request is followed step by step with a timer per step. Short heads-up messages tell you once when the cache is about to expire or a deploy finishes. A repo can choose its own cells in .claude/mods.json. Also adds /where.

preview.text: ▸ main ±3 · ◑ 38% · ◕ 47m left                      (quiet dock: click ▸ to open)
▾ repo main ±3 ↑2   docs current   context ◕ 78% [ Compress ]        cache ◕ 47m left [ Refresh ] [ ⚙ ▾ ]
shipping · 5m   ✔ tests 2m   ✔ version <1m   ✔ pull request <1m   ▶ merge 1m   · deploy   · verify
merge  CI running · 7m          merge started 14:32 (still going) · Deploy
heads-up (shows once, then fades):  ✔ Shipped in 9m.   ·   Cache expires in 8m. Press Refresh to keep it warm.
Compress asks first: "Compress this conversation?"  [ Yes, compress ] [ Cancel ]
⚙ ▾ dropdowns: cache lifetime, keep alive, idle stop, warn level, quiet dock / full strip / only when needed, heads-ups on or off

mods.cost: Checking is free. Refresh and the optional Auto keep-alive read your cached context (about 10% of normal input price). Compress is one summarizing call. Auto is off by default.
mods.needs: git for the repo and docs cells; the GitHub CLI (gh) for the deploy cell. Optional .claude/deploy-verify.json with a healthUrl, and .claude/mods.json to pick a repo's cells, for example {"cells": ["repo", "context", "cache"], "show": "dock"}.

mods.name: next-steps
mods.summary: Tick the next steps you want, instead of typing them
mods.where: A bordered panel above the prompt whenever nothing is running: at the start of a session, after each reply, and after a stopped reply. Tick one or more options, preview what will be sent, then Send. Each row also has a one-click send. You can still type anything.

preview.text: │ What would you like to do next?              2 selected  × │
│ 1  [x] Run the tests and show me the results          send │
│ 2  [ ] Review what changed and point out any problems send │
│ 3  [x] Commit and push the changes                    send │
│ ✎  Something else: just type below                  [ Skip ] │
│ [ Send selected (2) ] [ Edit selected ]    New ideas  Off  │

mods.cost: One small request per reply to a small, fast model, using only your latest request and Claude's latest reply (a couple of thousand input tokens). Turn it off with Off or /next.
mods.needs: Nothing. Options appear within a second or two; if the tailored ones are slow, built-in suggestions show first and are swapped in. If Claude proposed options, those come first.

mods.name: ship-it
mods.summary: A bare "deploy it" becomes the full ship checklist
mods.where: No screen element: it adds hidden context to your prompt and shows a toast.

preview.text: Claude also reads:  Standing ship checklist: gates, version bump, PR, merge, deploy, CI, live check
toast:              ship-it: attached the ship checklist

mods.cost: A few hundred extra tokens, only on those short deploy/merge prompts.
mods.needs: A repo that documents its deploy steps (otherwise Claude stops and asks).

mods.name: usage-guard
mods.summary: Usage in the bottom bar as small circles, with the reset time; guards agent fan-out
mods.where: The bottom bar under the message box, plus a toast when an agent starts near a limit.

preview.text: toast (85%+): usage-guard: 5h usage at 88% — starting "Audit sessions"
blocked (97%+): new agents are refused until the limit resets

mods.needs: A plan that reports rate-limit usage. It may replace another status line entry.
